name: Dashboard Enhanced Activity Feed + Quick Actions

content.description: Replace the current simple activity feed (plain text + timestamp) with a categorized feed showing events from bookings, vessels, customs, processes, and approvals. Each entry has a category icon, color-coded dot, descriptive message, and relative timestamp. Also expand the quick actions from 4 to 8 items covering key shipping operations. Add process execution events from peEventLog table. Feed shows latest 15 events merged and sorted by timestamp.

activity_feed_enhancements.sort: by createdAt descending, merge all sources

acceptance_criteria: Activity feed shows up to 15 events from 5 data sources (bookings, customs, processes, approvals, event log)
Each feed item has a category-colored dot (blue/amber/violet/emerald/slate) and descriptive message
Feed items show relative time (Just now, 5m ago, 2h ago, 3d ago)
Feed items are sorted by createdAt descending across all sources
Quick actions expanded from 4 to 8 items covering key operations
Quick actions include: New Booking, Track Container, Vessel Schedule, Live Tracking, Process Hub, Customs Filing, Freight Invoice, AI Agents
Each quick action has an icon and navigates to the correct hub/page
Activity feed queries include tenantId filter and deletedAt IS NULL
Process events query from peEventLog ordered by createdAt DESC limit 5
Process instances query from peProcessInstances ordered by updatedAt DESC limit 5
Approval events query decided approvals from peApprovals ordered by decidedAt DESC limit 5
Dark mode support on all elements
Empty state preserved if no activity exists
edge_cases: All data sources empty — show existing empty state
Only one source has data — feed shows just those items
Very recent events (seconds ago) — show 'Just now'
Process event types with underscores — format as Title Case with spaces
Approval without decision yet — skip (only show decided approvals in feed)
error_handling: Any individual query failure — val() fallback returns empty array, feed shows remaining items
All queries fail — show empty state
security_considerations: tenantId filter mandatory on ALL queries
content.implementation_notes: Rewrite the ActivityFeed component at src/components/dashboard/activity-feed.tsx to accept categorized items with category field and color. Add 3 new queries to Promise.allSettled in page.tsx: recent process instances (index 24), recent decided approvals (index 25), recent event log entries (index 26). Merge all activity sources into a single sorted array. Update quick actions array in page.tsx JSX from 4 to 8 items with correct icons and hrefs.
affected_files: src/components/dashboard/activity-feed.tsx — REWRITE: categorized feed with colored dots and category icons
src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx — add 3 queries (processes, approvals, events), merge activity sources, expand quick actions to 8
testing_requirements: Activity feed shows categorized items from multiple sources
Items are correctly sorted by timestamp
Category colors render correctly per source
Quick actions expanded to 8 with correct navigation
Empty state still works when no data exists
